text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
…"Tracen-themed chocolate confectionery"… 
…What essential element am I lacking—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Father…? —Hallo?

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Guten Tag, Schatz. …Heard about the contest from the 
Yuushun Confectionery rep. How are preparations proceeding?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"…Ah. According to plan. I intend to deliver precise 
results worthy of the competition."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"…Good. —Flash. You are familiar with Schwarzwälder 
Kirschtorte, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"? Ja. The regional specialty inspired by the Black 
Forest of the Schwarzwald, prepared with kirschwasser, 
correct?"

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Ja. Origins vary, but tradition holds the cream 
represents winter snow, shaved chocolate depicts forest soil, 
and cherries honor local harvest."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Though far from the Schwarzwald now, tasting 
that Kirschtorte immediately evokes the Black Forest."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"The biting snow, ancient woodland, ripe cherries. Knowing 
those elements have endured and been cherished for centuries 
stirs genuine emotion."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "…Father…"

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"…Tracen Academy lacks centuries of heritage. Replicating 
the historical resonance of traditional Kirschtorte 
will prove challenging."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, it is home to dedicated students like yourself. 
It surely holds motifs capable of stirring equal passion."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text: "If I were in your position, I would identify that essence."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—In conclusion: our concept must transcend superficial 
ideas like 'races' or 'grounds.' It must stir genuine emotion.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I put the question to you all. What stirs your 
emotions here… what defines the true appeal of Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
…! An unexpected outcome. The diversity of perspectives 
is far wider than calculated… Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A unified motif requires coherence. With scattered input, 
we must either select a single focus or identify common overlap.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I propose conducting individual interviews to refine 
and standardize our core motif… Any objections?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Proposal. A higher-efficiency method exists 
beyond individual verbal interviews.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gooood moooorning!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O. Stations herself at the main gate 
punctually at 07:50 to conduct greetings for 30 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Correct! My standard morning protocol! 
Proper greetings are the foundation of discipline! 
A fundamental duty of an exemplary class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Lunchtime! Classmates! Submitting modern literature 
assignments now! Line up and hand them over briskly, please!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Ah, right on time. Appreciate it as always, Baku-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! Naturally! Leave everything to your class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A booming greeting, Bakushin! 
A reliable president, Bakushin! 
Exemplary study habits, Bakushin! 
Sprint full speed ahead, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes evening Bakushin conditioning! 
Until tomorrow, have a productive rest and good niiight!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Direct observation proves far more informative. 
Her daily schedule adheres to strict, relentless drive.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O's dedication to school life is evident… 
far clearer than simple verbal inquiry could convey.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Empirical data collection enhances motif analysis. 
Recommend continuing field observations to simulate 
all subjects' daily routines.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Yaaawn, dead tired rn—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? What's with the stalker squad? Oh wait. 
That shadowing project thing today?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*munch munch*… So good~ Weather's lit today, 
vibes are immaculate, right? …Wait, waaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Keep it down. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Forgot period 5 homework due today! Total disaster!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, look at this! Super cute, want it so bad… 
Ugh never mind, zero cash.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Yo Jordan, isn't your middle nail chipped?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, for real?! My nails are my winning strat! 
…Where'd I leave the topcoat?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
High aesthetic dedication, especially regarding nail maintenance. 
Her broad social network is equally noteworthy… Intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Looks like my turn next… I-I'll do my best! 
Um, looking forward to working with you…!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Flower! Sorry to bother, but I got totally 
stuck on yesterday's assignment… Could you explain it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! With pleasure! If my explanation helps!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I prepare a bento every morning. On sunny days, 
I like eating out in the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And… um, I packed portions for both of you today too. 
If you wouldn't mind, would you join me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually tending a small rented patch for strawberries. 
Hoping we can all share the harvest come spring.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Quick check done, heading to track practice next. …Was 
any of this useful? Hope I helped properly…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Extremely. …Hehe. Vibrant foliage and healthy soil. 
You maintain this entire plot unassisted?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mostly, yes. But winter prep gets a bit heavy. 
Wish I had a little more strength to manage alone, but…
